name: PLET, PLEM and riser bases
description: Pipeline end termination (PLET), pipeline end manifold (PLEM) and riser-base structures tie a flowline or riser to the seabed and provide the connection point, with a mudmat and levelling interface.

gaps.what: PLET weight, connection size and mudmat bearing requirement
gaps.why: No page read gives a PLET weight, hub size or mudmat bearing value.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a PLET datasheet or tie-in report and record weight, connection size and bearing requirement

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
